fact: WHO's Chad office reports that over the 2024-2025 biennium its support contributed to the validation of the Annuaire statistique 2024, the updating and integration of reporting tools in DHIS2 and the validation of the procedures manual for health information, and that the Stratégie nationale de santé numérique was adopted; it also says WHO prepared the digitisation of pilot hospitals, planned for 2026.
title: Rapport des résultats biennal 2024-2025
publisher: Organisation mondiale de la Santé, Bureau pays du Tchad
